We have developed pulse sequences for nonlinear ultrasound imaging that are valid under large-signal operation of capacitive micomachined ultrasonic (CMUT) transducers and piezoelectric systems.

(1) a new pulse sequence using N+1 consecutive phase modulations is presented for nonlinear ultrasound imaging with capacitive micromechanical ultrasonic transducers, and (2) the same pulse sequence is applicable to piezoelectric systems with nonlinearities that have a linear relationship between the input drive signal and each harmonic distortion component.
